title: Compliance Specialist
description:
Compliance Specialist

We are seeking a remote, full-time SOC 2 Compliance Specialist with expertise in SaaS environments and proficiency in using compliance management platforms (preferably Vanta). The ideal candidate will lead the client's SOC 2 compliance efforts, streamline evidence collection, ensure continuous monitoring, and support security and compliance programs to meet industry standards and customer expectations.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Compliance Management : Lead the end-to-end process for achieving and maintaining SOC 2 compliance, including scoping, evidence collection, control implementation, and audit preparation using Vanta's platform
  • Vanta Platform Utilization : Leverage Vanta's AI and automation tools to streamline compliance workflows, monitor controls, and manage vendor risk assessments
  • Continuous Monitoring : Implement and oversee continuous monitoring processes to ensure ongoing adherence to SOC 2 requirements and other relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)
  • Policy Development : Develop, update, and maintain security and compliance policies, procedures, and documentation within Vantas' centralized platform
  • Vendor Risk Management : Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards
  • Audit Support : Collaborate with external auditors to facilitate smooth and efficient SOC 2 audits, utilizing Vanta's tools to provide real-time evidence and reporting
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations
  • Training and Awareness : Conduct training sessions for employees on SOC 2 compliance requirements and best practices for maintaining a secure SaaS environment
  • Reporting and Metrics : Use Vanta's reporting features to track compliance metrics, generate reports, and communicate the company's security posture to internal stakeholders and external clients
  • Stay Updated : Keep abreast of evolving compliance frameworks, security standards, and Vanta platform updates to ensure alignment with industry best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, information security, or risk management, with a focus on SOC 2 compliance in a SaaS environment
  • Hands-on experience with Vanta or similar compliance automation platforms
  • Proven track record of successfully managing SOC 2 audits and implementing controls
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architecture, cloud security, and data privacy principles
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or NIST CSF
  • Proficiency in using compliance automation platforms for evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and vendor risk management
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills to manage complex compliance initiatives
  • Strong communication skills to liaise with technical teams, auditors, and leadership
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or SOC 2-specific training)
  • Familiarity with Vanta's AI Agent and other advanced features for GRC automation.
  • Experience working with startups, mid-market, or enterprise organizations in a SaaS environment
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively and efficiently. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.


We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers . This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí .


Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.


Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.


If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!


Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.



At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

description:
Key responsabilities:


-Coordinate the transportation and customs clearance of goods from the country of origin to our warehouse facilities.

-Manage inbound and outbound operations of our 3PL, ensuring timely and accurate processing of orders.

-Allocate stock to orders for wholesale distribution based on priorities and delivery windows.

-Forecast sales and communicate with sales teams regarding any potential delivery delays.

-Establish and Monitor SLAs and ensure compliance with established performance metrics.

-Provide world-class customer service to our clients, promptly addressing any inquiries or concerns.

-Lead and mentor a team responsible for executing logistics operations.


Must have:

-You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.

-You bring proven solid experience in operations and logistics, preferably in a startup or fast-paced environment.

-You can thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

-You have leadership experience, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team towards achieving common goals.

-You understand import/export regulations and customs procedures well.

-Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, or a related field.


Note:

Contract Type: Independent Contractor

title: Sales Assistant
description:
Job Title: Owner Relations Specialist (Remote) – Property Management

Compensation: $850/month (remote, full-time)

About Us:

We are a fast-growing property management company specializing in short-term rentals. Our focus is on providing seamless, top-quality service to both homeowners and guests. We are seeking a professional, organized, and efficient Owner Relations Specialist to join our remote team.

Position Overview:

The Owner Relations Specialist will be the primary point of contact for our homeowners. You will communicate with property owners, relay information to our internal teams, and ensure that all requests are handled promptly and professionally. This role requires excellent English communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to stay organized in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the main liaison between homeowners and our internal teams
  • Handle homeowner inquiries with professionalism and efficiency
  • Ensure homeowners are updated on property matters and requests are addressed in a timely manner
  • Coordinate with operations, maintenance, and guest communication teams to resolve issues
  • Maintain accurate records of homeowner interactions and follow-ups

Qualifications:

  • Excellent English (both written and spoken)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive
  • Previous experience in property management, hospitality, or customer relations is a plus
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Compensation:

  • $850/month (remote, full-time)

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a growing, dynamic property management company
  • Remote role with a supportive team environment
  • Opportunity to take ownership of a key role in the business

If you are a professional with strong communication skills and a passion for delivering excellent service, we’d love to hear from you!

Application Instructions:

To apply, please:

  • Record a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself and explaining why you’d be a great fit for this role.
  • Send your CV and Loom video link to:

We look forward to meeting professionals who are ready to bring efficiency, organization, and excellent communication to our team!

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 54563


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 6 anos atuando JAVA, com versões atuais, Springboot e Quarkus;

- Experiência em AWS ( Lambda, S3, CloudFormation, EC2, SQS e RDS);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de APIs e automações;

- Atuar profissionalmente com JavaScript e Angular 2+ para aplicações web;

- OCR para extração e leitura de informações em imagens e documentos.

- Docker para padronização e conteinerização de ambiente;

- Experiência em Grafana para monitoramento e análise de métricas;

- Experiência com Langfuse e LangChain para integração e desenvolvimento de soluções com IA generativa;

- Fundamentos de IA, Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Linguagem Natural;

- Fundamentos de Engenharia de Dados (ETL, modelagem e transformação);

- Experiência com RAG.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Desenvolvedor com foco em automações de processos e IA
description:
O Grupo NTSec é o resultado da união da ZivaSec , NTSec , InfoSec e CloudSec , empresas do mercado de tecnologia. Somos uma plataforma de soluções inovadoras em segurança, com talentos excepcionais e o compromisso de conectar o futuro dos nossos clientes à proteção que eles precisam.

Com mais de 300 profissionais que chamamos de Secpowers ⚡ espalhados em todo o Brasil e temos escritórios em Brasília (DF), Cuiabá (MT), Curitiba (PR), Fortaleza (CE), Goiânia (GO), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , estamos em constante expansão.


Reconhecidos 3 vezes pelo Great Place to Work™ , temos uma cultura forte, baseada em inovação, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade e respeito .


Se você se identifica com esse ambiente, essa vaga pode ser sua!


Estamos em busca de um desenvolvedor de novas soluções e integrações com Inteligência Artificial para fazer parte do nosso time de tecnologia. Este profissional será responsável por criar, integrar, manter e automatizar soluções utilizando técnicas de programação e aplicação de inteligência artificial, apoiando os projetos de inovação e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Dentro do time suas principais responsabilidades serão:


  • Desenvolver integrações entre sistemas utilizando ferramentas de automação e programação.
  • Criar e manter fluxos de automação.
  • Aplicar conceitos de inteligência artificial para otimizar e automatizar processos.
  • Desenvolver scripts e aplicações utilizando a linguagem de programação Python.
  • Propor e implementar soluções técnicas inovadoras para demandas internas e externas.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando Power BI (diferencial).


Requisitos e qualificações:


Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:


  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas (completa ou cursando).


Experiência sólida com:


  • Ferramentas e frameworks de LLMs, como OpenAI, Hugging Face, LangChain ,NLP, RAG, Agentes, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, entre outras.
  • Python (Scripting, APIs, integração de sistemas e com banco de dados).
  • HTML/CSS e JavaScript (desenvolvimento web).
  • Plataforma de automação n8n.
  • Banco de dados relacional PostgreSQL (Vector Store).
  • Versionamento de código-fonte utilizando Git.
  • Criação e integração de APIs REST/SOAP.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em modelagem de banco de dados e estruturas SQL.


É um diferencial se você tiver:


  • Conhecimentos em Power BI (construção de relatórios e dashboards).
  • Experiência com outras linguagens de automação ou integração de processos (Node.js, JavaScript, etc).
  • Conhecimento em N8N.


E aí, deu match!? Então vem fazer parte do nosso time de secpowers ! ⚡

title: Sales Associate Assistant Manager
description:
Company: Home Alliance


Location: Remote (Global – aligned with U.S. business hours)


Home Alliance is looking for a proactive, results-driven Partnership Campaign & Sales Assistant to help fuel our rapid growth in the facility management and home services industry.

You’ll play a key role in executing multi-touch outreach campaigns (calls, emails, SMS) — driving new partnerships, nurturing relationships, and closing deals with qualified warm leads.

If you’re a motivated communicator who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys turning conversations into business relationships, this opportunity is for you.



What You’ll Do
  • Conduct proactive outreach (calls, emails, SMS) to potential B2B/B2C partners
  • Manage and nurture a pipeline of partnership prospects from first contact to deal closure
  • Qualify warm leads and schedule calls, presentations, and demos with decision-makers
  • Negotiate and close partnership agreements aligned with company objectives
  • Maintain accurate records in CRM; prepare reports on outreach activity and pipeline status
  • Support development and optimization of scripts, templates, and campaign materials
  • Act as a brand ambassador, ensuring a positive and professional partner experience



What We’re Looking For
  • 2+ years of experience in B2B or B2B2C sales, ideally in home services, facility management, or related fields
  • Proven success in direct sales, partnership management, or business development
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to identify key decision-makers and build rapport quickly via calls and digital channels
  • Tech-savvy — comfortable working with CRM and sales automation tools
  • Highly organized, accountable, and driven by measurable goals



Nice to Have
  • Experience in facility management, HVAC, pest control, or cleaning services
  • Familiarity with affiliate or partnership program models
  • Experience running multi-channel outbound campaign



Why Join Us
  • Work with a fast-growing company redefining home services and facility management
  • 100% remote position with flexible schedule (U.S. hours overlap preferred)
  • Competitive compensation + performance-based bonuses
  • Direct collaboration with leadership and opportunity for growth in business development


If you’re a proactive communicator who loves building partnerships and driving measurable results — we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now!

title: Profissional Fullstack Python e Angular - Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga


Código da vaga: 54387


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Domínio de Angular 12+ (incluindo TypeScript, RxJS e Angular Material).
  • Conhecimento avançado em HTML5, CSS3 e SCSS .
  • Prática com design responsivo e metodologia mobile-first .
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de estado (NgRx ou Akita ).

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,500 - $5,500 USD


Our partner is entering their next phase of growth, expanding their platform and building intelligent systems that transform how banks and credit unions understand and serve their small business customers. They are looking for a hands-on Applied AI Engineer to own everything agentic and generative AI within their organization. As their in-house expert, the selected candidate will design and build systems that integrate large language models into production, support their analytics platform, and lay the groundwork for a next-generation, AI-powered customer experience. They will deliver meaningful impact and have full visibility from day one.


What You’ll Do:

  • Design and build production-grade generative and agentic AI systems, from prompt design and model selection through to orchestration and deployment.
  • Fine-tune and integrate third-party models into their platform and customer workflows.
  • Develop and maintain pipelines, tools, and infrastructure to deliver reliable and scalable AI features.
  • Collaborate with the engineering team to deploy and monitor AI services in production.
  • Establish best practices for AI evaluation, safety, and continuous improvement.
  • Help define their AI technical strategy and roadmap.


What You Bring:

  • Strong experience designing, building, and productionizing AI-driven or agentic systems.
  • Deep understanding of LLM orchestration, context management, and prompt engineering.
  • Experience with cloud environments and monitoring or evaluating deployed AI services.
  • Experience working with APIs and SDKs from leading model providers.
  • Proficiency in Python and familiarity with backend integration workflows.
  • Comfort working in small, fast-moving teams with limited technical oversight.
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive mindset.


Bonus Points For:

  • Familiarity with modern frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or DSPy.
  • Experience with vector databases, embedding pipelines, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Deep understanding of transformer architecture.
  • Fintech or data-intensive SaaS experience.


What You’ll Get:

  • The opportunity to define and build the AI foundation of a fast-growing startup.
  • Competitive compensation.
  • Fully remote work model, with the opportunity to occasionally collaborate in person.
  • Fast-moving, engaging environment with a team that values both ambition and fun.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to make a huge impact in an early-stage company defining a new category in financial technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Customer Success Representative
description:
About MeetGeek

MeetGeek is an AI meeting assistant that doesn't just listen, it acts. We help teams automate meeting capture, summarization, and now, with agentic AI workflows, MeetGeek becomes an active participant in meetings, surfacing data, triggering automations, and even taking actions on your behalf.

From Zoom to Teams to Google Meet, MeetGeek integrates with 5,000+ tools like HubSpot, Slack, Notion, Salesforce, and more — helping revenue, product, and operations teams turn conversations into structured workflows.

Thousands of companies in 100+ countries already trust us. Backed by top-tier investors and led by a team of AI, NLP, and systems engineering veterans, MeetGeek is redefining what meetings can do.

It's a great time to join MeetGeek. We’re a quickly growing remote team, well-funded, and helping thousands of teams improve their meetings.


About MeetGeek

We’re looking for a Customer Success Representative (Junior) who’s passionate about helping customers succeed — and curious about what’s next in AI, automation, and workflow design.

This role blends customer support, customer success, and operations . You’ll help users go beyond meeting notes and unlock the full power of MeetGeek’s agentic capabilities — from automated follow-ups to real-time action triggers.


About the Role

Technical Troubleshooting

Support users through questions about agent setup, integrations, or system behavior. Collaborate with engineering to resolve edge cases.

title: DDI Network Engineer (LATAM)
description:
SONDA is the largest IT service provider in Latin America, leader in systems integration, support and IT outsourcing. With almost 50 years of experience and in constant growth around the World, and growing so far in in US, as well.


We are seeking DDI Network Engineers (DNS/DHCP/IPAM) to join a strategic, supply chain–level project with one of our key clients in the US, focused on migrating and reorganizing network records. This professional will play a key role in executing planned changes, ensuring operational continuity and the reliability of the network infrastructure.


Responsibilities

  • Perform migration of DNS/DHCP records, VLANs, and other network configurations across multiple sites.
  • Execute approximately four weekly changes (including weekend work when necessary).
  • Ensure stability, security, and availability of network services during and after changes.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure and operations teams to align schedules and minimize impact on production environments.
  • Document processes, changes, and outcomes of each activity performed.
  • Contribute to best practices for DNS, DHCP, and IPAM (DDI) management and suggest continuous improvements.


Requirements

  • Proven experience with administration of DNS, DHCP, and IPAM (DDI) in corporate environments.
  • Solid knowledge of VLANs, TCP/IP, subnets, and network protocols .
  • Hands-on experience with IPAM management tools (e.g., Infoblox, BlueCat, or equivalents).
  • Ability to work on migration projects and large distributed environments.
  • Skilled at handling critical changes with tight windows (including weekends).
  • Technical English for documentation and communication with global teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in supply chain or large-scale network environments .
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Cisco, CompTIA Network+, ITIL, Infoblox NIOS).
  • Previous experience in nearshore projects and collaboration with international teams.

title: Fullstack Developer
description:
Job Title: Full Stack Developer (Pleno / Senior) iGaming

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Languages: Portuguese & English


A licensed online casino is launching a brand-new operation in Brazil, and we’re looking for skilled professionals to join as foundational members of our technical team.


This isn’t a typical startup story — we’re building on the massive success of a social casino brand that has operated in Brazil for a number of years and has a mature CRM. Now, we’re leveraging that legacy to deliver a fresh and unique casino experience in a highly competitive market.


As a Full Stack Developer, you’ll play a core role in shaping this greenfield project, working directly with leadership, product, and DevOps teams to build a secure, scalable, and engaging platform — completely free from legacy code.


What You’ll Do:

  • Design & Develop: Build core components of the frontend (Next.js) and backend-for-frontend (Node.js) for a B2C platform, contributing significantly to the technical roadmap.
  • Deliver Core Features: Develop critical user-facing features such as registration/login flows, a dynamic game lobby, and loyalty/gamification systems.
  • Lead Integrations: Implement integrations with licensed operator APIs for wallet, authentication, and KYC.
  • Cloud & DevOps Collaboration: Work hands-on with AWS infrastructure (ECS, RDS, S3, etc.) and partner with DevOps to maintain CI/CD pipelines with high availability.
  • Code Quality & Culture: Write secure, testable, and high-quality code while contributing to a culture of technical excellence through reviews and collaboration.


What You Bring:

  • 4+ years of full stack development experience, with a proven track record using React/Next.js, Node.js, and PHP.
  • Strong knowledge of modern frontend architecture, API design, and security principles for handling sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS in production (ECS, EC2, RDS, CloudWatch).
  • A product-focused mindset, thriving in fast-paced, cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills in English for collaboration with a distributed team.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous iGaming industry experience.
  • Familiarity with promotional/CRM tools (e.g., Smartico, Optimove).
  • Knowledge of video bingo, slots, or online casino products.
  • Professional proficiency in Spanish.


Why Join Us?

  • Greenfield Project: Build a platform from scratch with modern technology and zero legacy code.
  • Impact & Ownership: Be part of the founding team and directly shape the product’s success.
  • Proven Brand: Leverage an established user base of over 5 million.
  • Competitive Package: Attractive compensation and performance bonuses for top talent.
company: Clear Edge International Search & Selection Ltd

title: Desenvolvimento Kotlin, Java, Python AWS - 123816
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior


Requisitos:

Kotlin, com ênfase em Java Spring Boot, Python e AWS. Requisitos Técnicos: Kotlin (Habilidade Principal). Experiência com Kotlin para desenvolvimento backend. Conhecimento em frameworks como Ktor ou Spring Boot com Kotlin. Boas práticas de programação funcional e orientada a objetos em Kotlin. - Uso de coroutines para programação assíncrona. - Testes automatizados com JUnit, MockK ou Kotest. Java + Spring Boot. Experiência com Spring Boot e seus módulos (Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud). - Uso de JPA/Hibernate para persistência de dados. - Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e GraphQL. - Testes com JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers. Python. Conhecimento básico ou intermediário para **scripts, automação e integração**. - Experiência com frameworks como **FastAPI ou Flask** é um diferencial. - Manipulação de dados com **Pandas e NumPy** (caso necessário). **AWS (Cloud)** - Experiência com **AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, API Gateway e IAM**. - Infraestrutura como código (**Terraform, AWS CDK ou CloudFormation**). - Monitoramento e logging com **CloudWatch**. - Conhecimento em **ECS, EKS ou Kubernetes** é um diferencial. **Outros Conhecimentos Desejáveis** - Experiência com **CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)**. - Banco de dados **SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)**. - Mensageria com **Kafka ou RabbitMQ**. - Containers e Docker. - Arquitetura de microsserviços e eventos. Principais Responsabilidades do Desenvolvedor 1. Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento Backend Criar e manter microsserviços escaláveis usando Kotlin (Spring Boot). Projetar e desenvolver APIs REST e GraphQL. Implementar boas práticas de clean code, design patterns e SOLID. Gerenciar persistência de dados utilizando PostgreSQL, DynamoDB ou MongoDB. 2. Integração com AWS e Infraestrutura Desenvolver e otimizar soluções utilizando AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway e RDS. Criar pipelines de infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou AWS CDK). Implementar monitoramento e logging com AWS CloudWatch e Prometheus. 3. Processamento e Automação de Dados Construir pipelines de processamento de dados com Kafka ou AWS Kinesis. Criar automações e scripts auxiliares em Python para análise de dados, ETL ou machine learning. 4. Segurança e Performance Implementar OAuth2, JWT ou AWS Cognito para autenticação e autorização. Monitorar performance e escalabilidade, otimizando queries e serviços. 5. DevOps e CI/CD Automatizar deploys utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/Fargate ou EKS. Configurar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 6. Colaboração e Melhoria Contínua Trabalhar em equipe, revisando códigos (Code Review) e propondo melhorias. Manter documentação técnica clara e atualizada. Participar de decisões arquiteturais e estratégias de evolução do sistema.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
  • Conhecimento em Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend React Sênior
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?

Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend React Sênior, que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Tecnologia e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Ajudará a desenvolver uma arquitetura moderna, limpa e reutilizável para nossos novos APPs;
  • Utilizará tecnologias como híbridas como Cordova/Ionic/Capacitor;
  • Dará apoio na manutenção dos APPs já existentes;
  • Fará code reviews com atenção e cuidado;
  • Trabalhará com um time diverso, com capacidade multidisciplinar e que caminha alinhado ao encontro dos mesmos propósitos e resultados.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com React e TypeScript;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de estado como Redux e/ou Zustand;
  • Experiência com Capacitor e Firebase
  • Experiência com testes;
  • Experiência com Arquitetura de para Apps;
  • Experiência com aplicações frontend distribuídas (ex.: microfrontends).


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com CI/CD para AppStore e Google Play;
  • Conhecimento de métodos ágeis (scrum);
  • Experiência com React Native;
  • Experiência com Node;
  • Vivência em implementação e manutenção de design systems;
  • Experiência em refatoração de código em larga escala e definição de estratégias de refatoração.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ;
  • Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto: uma oportunidade de crescimento acessível para talentos em todo o Brasil;
  • ⚕Plano de Saúde: mantenha-se saudável com nosso abrangente plano de saúde nacional com consultas online e presenciais;
  • ♀️Wellhub/GymPass: bem-estar completo para você cuidar da sua saúde física e mental com os aplicativos integrados;
  • Voucher Kit Escritório: receba um voucher para turbinar o seu espaço de trabalho e garantir seu conforto, comodidade e produtividade;
  • Férias remuneradas: desfrute de 30 dias de férias remuneradas por ano para recarregar suas energias e relaxar;
  • Programa Super-Get-Super: indique um talento e receba um bônus;

Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?

Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend React Sênior, que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Tecnologia e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Ajudará a desenvolver uma arquitetura moderna, limpa e reutilizável para nossos novos APPs;
  • Utilizará tecnologias como híbridas como Cordova/Ionic/Capacitor;
  • Dará apoio na manutenção dos APPs já existentes;
  • Fará code reviews com atenção e cuidado;
  • Trabalhará com um time diverso, com capacidade multidisciplinar e que caminha alinhado ao encontro dos mesmos propósitos e resultados.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com React e TypeScript;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de estado como Redux e/ou Zustand;
  • Experiência com Capacitor e Firebase
  • Experiência com testes;
  • Experiência com Arquitetura de para Apps;
  • Experiência com aplicações frontend distribuídas (ex.: microfrontends).


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com CI/CD para AppStore e Google Play;
  • Conhecimento de métodos ágeis (scrum);
  • Experiência com React Native;
  • Experiência com Node;
  • Vivência em implementação e manutenção de design systems;
  • Experiência em refatoração de código em larga escala e definição de estratégias de refatoração.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ;
  • Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto: uma oportunidade de crescimento acessível para talentos em todo o Brasil;
  • ⚕Plano de Saúde: mantenha-se saudável com nosso abrangente plano de saúde nacional com consultas online e presenciais;
  • ♀️Wellhub/GymPass: bem-estar completo para você cuidar da sua saúde física e mental com os aplicativos integrados;
  • Voucher Kit Escritório: receba um voucher para turbinar o seu espaço de trabalho e garantir seu conforto, comodidade e produtividade;
  • Férias remuneradas: desfrute de 30 dias de férias remuneradas por ano para recarregar suas energias e relaxar;
  • Programa Super-Get-Super: indique um talento e receba um bônus;

title: Franchise Business Consultant - LATAM
description:
The Franchise Business Consultant – LATAM supports Master Franchise and Direct Franchise partners across Latin America by providing operational guidance, financial coaching, and training to drive performance while ensuring alignment with Gold’s Gym global standards. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English and proficiency in Spanish to effectively collaborate across diverse markets in the region. The FBC conducts regular market visits, virtual consultations, and leads both in-person and online training sessions. This is a remote role based out of the Brasil. Frequent travel throughout Latin America—up to 50% or more—is required.


Responsibilities:


Franchise Support & Coaching

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison for Master Franchise and Direct Franchise owners, offering consultative support on day-to-day operations, financial performance, leadership development, and member experience.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across culturally and linguistically diverse markets, ensuring business strategies align with Gold’s Gym standards while adapting to local market needs.
  • Conduct regular check-ins and annual in-person site visits with each franchise location in the assigned LATAM territory.
  • Provide guidance and resources to drive operational excellence and regional growth.
  • Leverage KPI benchmarks, and digital platforms to monitor and support franchise performance.


Training & Leadership Development

  • Develop and deliver in-person and virtual training sessions in Portuguese (and Spanish where applicable) for franchisees and their teams, focusing on operational efficiency, member experience, and profitability.
  • Facilitate webinars, learning sessions, and peer collaboration forums to promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing in the LATAM market.
  • Lead onboarding programs for new franchisees and gym leaders, providing a strong foundation in Gold’s Gym systems, standards, and growth strategies.
  • Champion the rollout of corporate initiatives, tools, and new programs, ensuring cultural adaptation and consistent adoption across locations.


Operational Evaluations & Brand Standards

  • Perform standardized gym evaluations, operational audits, and brand assessments.
  • Ensure all LATAM locations remain compliant with system standards, brand guidelines, and operational policies.


Strategic Business & Financial Planning

  • Review and interpret financial reports (P&Ls, balance sheets, KPIs) to identify trends and coach franchisees on strategies for profitability and operational improvement.
  • Assist with strategic planning, forecasting, and staff planning tailored to the LATAM region.


Market Insights & System Collaboration

  • Conduct annual market reviews and monitor competitive activity in each territory.
  • Share benchmarking data, performance insights, and market intelligence with both franchisees and internal teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, technology, and development teams to align LATAM field strategies with broader corporate objectives.


Skills & Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish required.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in franchise operations, business consulting, or multi-unit fitness/hospitality management.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Exercise Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead both in-person and virtual training programs in multiple languages.
  • Strong knowledge of fitness industry operations, financial drivers, and customer experience best practices.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and coaching skills, with a high degree of cultural intelligence.
  • Basic knowledge of gym technology platforms is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% or more across Latin America and Caribbean, including overnight travel and weekends when necessary.


Preferred Attributes

  • Passion for fitness, health, and wellness.
  • Experience supporting international franchise or multi-unit business models, particularly in Latin America.
  • Strong presence and confidence when leading groups and delivering training in culturally diverse environments.
  • High level of business acumen, adaptability, and emotional intelligence.
  • Familiarity with Gold’s Gym tools, systems, or service providers.

title: Especialista Microsoft AD (Integrações por API) - Sênior
description:
Responsabilidades:

Automatizar o ciclo de criação, alteração e exclusão de usuários no Active Directory (AD) e o respectivo provisionamento de e-mail.

Construir/operar integrações via API entre AD/Entra ID e a plataforma de e-mail (Microsoft 365/Exchange Online ou Exchange on-premises), incluindo gatilhos de onboarding/offboarding.

Manter sincronização (atributos, grupos, licenças) e governança de identidades (IAM).

Implementar logs, auditoria e tratamento de erros, com observabilidade.

Documentar fluxos, políticas e runbooks de operação.


Requisitos técnicos:

Experiência sólida em Active Directory (AD DS) e, preferencialmente, Entra ID (Azure AD).

PowerShell avançado para automação administrativa.

Integrações via APIs Microsoft Graph ou Exchange Online (EWS/PowerShell).

Conhecimento em provisionamento de mailboxes, aliases, domínios e licenciamento.

Entendimento de padrões REST/JSON e práticas de segurança (OAuth 2.0, app registrations, least privilege).


Detalhes da Contratação

  • Modelo Remoto .
  • Alocação: 3 meses temporário
  • Regime PJ padrão

Entendimento de padrões REST/JSON e práticas de segurança (OAuth 2.0, app registrations, least privilege).

title: Assistente contábil
description:
Venha para a Indústria São Miguel! Somos uma equipe unida pelo mesmo propósito. Dar todo o nosso espírito empreendedor para alimentar JUNTOS um futuro próspero.


Vaga para ASSISTENTE CONTÁBIL em SALVADOR/BA.


Missão: Controlar e executar atividades relacionados à área Contábil: classificação de despesas, análise e reconciliação de contas, registro de documentos e escritura livros fiscais. Atendendo aos requisitos legais e princípios da ISM.


Que perfil buscamos?

Imprescindível experiência com: IFRS , CPCs e Lucro Real, ECD, ECF.

Ensino superior completo ou cursando em Ciências Contábeis.

Experiência anterior na função, com rotinas contábeis e procedimentos básicos escrituração fiscal.

Manejo de MS Office, ERP Contábil/Finanças.


Quais serão seus desafios?

Reconciliar contas em tempo hábil, conforme procedimento interno e legislação em vigor.

Elaborar e atualizar relatórios da área para apreciação e análise do supervisor.

Acompanhar as legislações contábeis, visando a implementação das atualizações e o cumprimento das leis.

Garantir o cumprimento das normas de qualidade da instituição na execução de suas atividades.

Apoiar o fechamento contábil do período para elaboração de relatórios com propósito de apurar o desempenho financeiro da empresa e recolhimento dos impostos devidos.


O que nós oferecemos para você?

• Fazer parte de uma empresa líder, em fase de crescimento exponencial.

• Horário de trabalho: Segunda a sexta-feira.

• Localização: Rodovia BR 324, KM 619 – Loteamento Industrial, Salvador/BA.

• Vale Alimentação.

• Vale Refeição.

• Plano de saúde e odontológico.

• Desconto em Faculdades para cursos de graduação e pós graduação.

• TotalPASS.

• Vale Transporte.

• Cesta natalina.

title: BizOps
description:
Você é um(a) profissional que une pensamento analítico, visão estratégica e paixão por eficiência?

Se você tem domínio em automação, dados e otimização de processos de negócio, esta é a sua chance de impactar diretamente a operação da Ticto.


Como Você Pode Colaborar:

  • Mapear e automatizar processos internos, conectando áreas como Marketing, Vendas, CS, Financeiro e Produto.
  • Criar integrações entre ferramentas (CRM, ERP, plataformas de atendimento, automação de marketing, etc.).
  • Construir fluxos automatizados que aumentem produtividade e garantam dados consistentes em toda a operação.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares para entender gargalos e propor soluções inteligentes e escaláveis.
  • Estruturar pipelines de dados, acompanhar KPIs e criar alertas e dashboards para suporte à decisão.
  • Documentar e manter soluções com foco em reutilização, governança e escalabilidade.


O Que Estamos Buscando:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (n8n, Make, Zapier) ou scripts em Python/Node.js.
  • Domínio de SQL e integração de APIs RESTful.
  • Vivência com plataformas como Hubspot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Zendesk ou Intercom.
  • Capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócio em soluções técnicas.
  • Organização e habilidade de documentar e estruturar processos com clareza.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de dados (dbt, Airbyte, Supabase, Postgres).
  • Noções de análise e visualização de dados (Metabase, Looker).
  • Familiaridade com versionamento (Git) e background em Produto ou Engenharia.


✨ Na Ticto, você terá a oportunidade de deixar sua marca, impactando diretamente a criação de uma experiência de cliente inesquecível.

Se você tem domínio em automação, dados e otimização de processos de negócio, esta é a sua chance de impactar diretamente a operação da Ticto.


Como Você Pode Colaborar:

  • Mapear e automatizar processos internos, conectando áreas como Marketing, Vendas, CS, Financeiro e Produto.
  • Criar integrações entre ferramentas (CRM, ERP, plataformas de atendimento, automação de marketing, etc.).
  • Construir fluxos automatizados que aumentem produtividade e garantam dados consistentes em toda a operação.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares para entender gargalos e propor soluções inteligentes e escaláveis.
  • Estruturar pipelines de dados, acompanhar KPIs e criar alertas e dashboards para suporte à decisão.
  • Documentar e manter soluções com foco em reutilização, governança e escalabilidade.


O Que Estamos Buscando:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (n8n, Make, Zapier) ou scripts em Python/Node.js.
  • Domínio de SQL e integração de APIs RESTful.
  • Vivência com plataformas como Hubspot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Zendesk ou Intercom.
  • Capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócio em soluções técnicas.
  • Organização e habilidade de documentar e estruturar processos com clareza.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de dados (dbt, Airbyte, Supabase, Postgres).
  • Noções de análise e visualização de dados (Metabase, Looker).
  • Familiaridade com versionamento (Git) e background em Produto ou Engenharia.


✨ Na Ticto, você terá a oportunidade de deixar sua marca, impactando diretamente a criação de uma experiência de cliente inesquecível.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Pleno
description:
Descritivo:

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack com perfil Pleno, que tenha boa base técnica e vontade de crescer. Atuará no desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações web , integrando front-end (Angular/React) com back-end em .NET .


Informações:

Modelo de trabalho via contrato PJ;

Home Office;


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Angular e/ou React;
  • Conhecimento em C# e .NET / .NET Core;
  • Consumo e criação de APIs RESTful;
  • Noções de HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript;
  • Experiência com banco de dados SQL (SQL Server, MySQL, ou similar);
  • Uso de Git e ferramentas de versionamento.


Será um diferencial...

  • Conhecimento em framework DevExpress;
  • Experiência com Entity Framework, LINQ e Web Services;
  • Noções de arquitetura MVC / MVVM;
  • Práticas de CI/CD, Azure DevOps ou pipelines de integração;
  • Vivência com Docker e APIs em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP).


Atividades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando Angular e/ou React;
  • Criar e integrar APIs REST utilizando .NET / .NET Core;
  • Implementar boas práticas de versionamento (Git), componentização e testes unitários;
  • Apoiar a definição de arquitetura e padrões de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar com o cliente na resolução de problemas técnicos e evolução de funcionalidades;
  • Garantir qualidade, performance e segurança nas entregas.

Trabalhar em conjunto para entrega de soluções robustas e eficientes

Propor melhorias técnicas e participar ativamente das decisões de arquitetura

Escrever testes e garantir a qualidade do código


Por que essa vaga pode ser ideal pra você?

Ambiente de aprendizado contínuo e espaço para crescimento

Cultura de feedback

Autonomia e respeito

title: Social Sciences SME (Portuguese) - 47319
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview

We are looking for accomplished Tutors and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to contribute their expertise in Social Sciences, Humanities, and STEM disciplines . In this role, you will design, evaluate, and review advanced academic tasks that test critical thinking, reasoning, and subject mastery . Your input will directly help improve AI models by ensuring they can handle complex, graduate-level questions across disciplines.


What You’ll Do

  • Create structured, graduate-level tasks, prompts, and problem sets in your area of expertise.
  • Contribute to fields including Social Sciences, Humanities (history, literature, philosophy, etc.), and STEM (math, physics, biology, engineering, computer science, etc.).
  • Quality assurance: Assess AI-generated outputs for accuracy, depth, and rigor.
  • Pinpoint where models fail to reason correctly and provide expert corrections.
  • Maintain clear, organized records of tasks, solutions, and evaluations.

Requirements

  • Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, or Postdoctoral experience) in your field of expertise.
  • Strong subject knowledge in one or more disciplines within Social Sciences, Humanities, or STEM.
  • Excellent academic writing and analytical skills.
  • Ability to design structured, verifiable assessment questions.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work on the cutting edge of AI.
  • Fully remote and flexible work environment.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and insight into how they’re trained.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: minimum 20 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.

In this role, you will design, evaluate, and review advanced academic tasks that test critical thinking, reasoning, and subject mastery . Your input will directly help improve AI models by ensuring they can handle complex, graduate-level questions across disciplines.


What You’ll Do

  • Create structured, graduate-level tasks, prompts, and problem sets in your area of expertise.
  • Contribute to fields including Social Sciences, Humanities (history, literature, philosophy, etc.), and STEM (math, physics, biology, engineering, computer science, etc.).
  • Quality assurance: Assess AI-generated outputs for accuracy, depth, and rigor.
  • Pinpoint where models fail to reason correctly and provide expert corrections.
  • Maintain clear, organized records of tasks, solutions, and evaluations.

Requirements

  • Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, or Postdoctoral experience) in your field of expertise.
  • Strong subject knowledge in one or more disciplines within Social Sciences, Humanities, or STEM.
  • Excellent academic writing and analytical skills.
  • Ability to design structured, verifiable assessment questions.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work on the cutting edge of AI.
  • Fully remote and flexible work environment.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and insight into how they’re trained.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: minimum 20 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.

title: Student Intern – Podcast Representative ( Chinese Language)
description:
Job Title: Student Intern – Podcast Representative (Chinese Language)

Location: Remote


About the Role:

We are seeking enthusiastic and articulate individuals who are fluent in Chinese (Mandarin) to join as Remote Podcast Representatives . This entry-level opportunity is perfect for students or freshers who enjoy conversations on general topics, have good speaking confidence, and can record engaging podcast-style discussions in Chinese.


Responsibilities:

  • Participate in discussions on general, everyday topics in Chinese (non-technical) .
  • Speak clearly, naturally, and confidently while maintaining a pleasant tone.
  • Follow the discussion themes and recording guidelines provided by the team.
  • Ensure clear audio quality while recording (quiet background, stable setup).
  • Work collaboratively with the team and be open to feedback for improvement.


System Requirements:

  • A laptop or desktop with a reliable Wi-Fi connection (mandatory).
  • Condenser headphones are mandatory to ensure high-quality audio recording.

title: Project Manager
description:
Join Aditi Consulting as a Project Manager!



Elevate your career as a Project Manager and become part of a dynamic, innovative team at Aditi Consulting . Our proven success in deploying top-tier professionals has earned us recognition among America’s fastest-growing companies. As we continue to expand, seize the opportunity to lead impactful projects, collaborate with exceptional talent, and grow in a supportive and forward-thinking environment.


Key Qualifications:

• 5–7+ years of experience in IT Program/Project Management, preferably within large enterprise environments.

• Proven experience in M&A integrations, including application rationalization, data migration, and change management.

• Strong technical acumen with a solid understanding of architecture, data flows, APIs, middleware, and system dependencies.

• Knowledge of both legacy and modern technology stacks, with experience in application reengineering and consolidations.

• Excellent cross-functional leadership skills; comfortable working with business, technical, and vendor teams.

• Proficiency in Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery models.

• Hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent.

• Familiarity with integration platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Boomi, Informatica).

  • • Skilled in risk, budget, and timeline management, with the ability to navigate complex program dependencies and constraints.


Benefits we offer:

Cell phone and internet reimbursements

Four-monthly salary reviews

Monthly virtual after-office with credit in a delivery app

Quarterly after-office outside the office with the team

Medical insurance (Bradesco) – 100% covered for the employee

⚕️ Doctor for virtual support

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Scrum Master (SAP)
description:
Sobre a Motivus

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Visão Geral da Posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) Scrum Master Sênior para se juntar à nossa equipe dinâmica.

Buscamos um(a) profissional com:

✅ Experiência sólida como Scrum Master em projetos SAP

✅ Atuação em implementações SAP (S/4HANA desejável)

✅ Vivência em projetos globais e times distribuídos

✅ Inglês intermediário/avançado, para interação com stakeholders internacionais


Responsabilidades

• Atuar como Scrum Master em projetos SAP, garantindo o cumprimento dos princípios e práticas ágeis.

• Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Review, Retrospective, Refinement).

• Apoiar o time no planejamento e execução das sprints, removendo impedimentos e promovendo a melhoria contínua.

• Fomentar a colaboração entre equipes técnicas e funcionais SAP e stakeholders globais.

• Trabalhar em estreita parceria com Product Owners, Líderes Funcionais SAP e PMOs, garantindo entregas consistentes e alinhadas aos objetivos do projeto.


Requisitos

• Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master em projetos de implementação SAP.

• Conhecimento sólido em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

• Capacidade de atuar em ambiente global e multicultural.

• Inglês intermediário/avançado (leitura, escrita e comunicação com times globais).

• Experiência com projetos complexos e times distribuídos.

• Certificação CSM, PSM ou equivalente será um diferencial.


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.

Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.

Ambiente Colaborativo: Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.

Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo(a) a progredir em sua carreira.

Abordagem Centrada no Cliente: Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.



Nossos Valores

Cultura de Inovação: Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.

Responsabilidade: Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.

Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.


Como se candidatar?

Os(as) candidatos(as) interessados(as) podem se inscrever enviando seu currículo para ou através deste anúncio.


A Motivus é um empregador que promove a igualdade de oportunidades e incentiva a diversidade e inclusão no local de trabalho.

Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Visão Geral da Posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) Scrum Master Sênior para se juntar à nossa equipe dinâmica.

Buscamos um(a) profissional com:

✅ Experiência sólida como Scrum Master em projetos SAP

✅ Atuação em implementações SAP (S/4HANA desejável)

✅ Vivência em projetos globais e times distribuídos

✅ Inglês intermediário/avançado, para interação com stakeholders internacionais


Responsabilidades

• Atuar como Scrum Master em projetos SAP, garantindo o cumprimento dos princípios e práticas ágeis.

• Fomentar a colaboração entre equipes técnicas e funcionais SAP e stakeholders globais.

• Trabalhar em estreita parceria com Product Owners, Líderes Funcionais SAP e PMOs, garantindo entregas consistentes e alinhadas aos objetivos do projeto.


Requisitos

• Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master em projetos de implementação SAP.

• Conhecimento sólido em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Social Sciences Tutor (Portuguese) - 47319
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview

We are looking for accomplished Tutors and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to contribute their expertise in Social Sciences, Humanities, and STEM disciplines . In this role, you will design, evaluate, and review advanced academic tasks that test critical thinking, reasoning, and subject mastery . Your input will directly help improve AI models by ensuring they can handle complex, graduate-level questions across disciplines.


What You’ll Do

  • Create structured, graduate-level tasks, prompts, and problem sets in your area of expertise.
  • Contribute to fields including Social Sciences, Humanities (history, literature, philosophy, etc.), and STEM (math, physics, biology, engineering, computer science, etc.).
  • Quality assurance: Assess AI-generated outputs for accuracy, depth, and rigor.
  • Pinpoint where models fail to reason correctly and provide expert corrections.
  • Maintain clear, organized records of tasks, solutions, and evaluations.

Requirements

  • Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, or Postdoctoral experience) in your field of expertise.
  • Strong subject knowledge in one or more disciplines within Social Sciences, Humanities, or STEM.
  • Excellent academic writing and analytical skills.
  • Ability to design structured, verifiable assessment questions.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work on the cutting edge of AI.
  • Fully remote and flexible work environment.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and insight into how they’re trained.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: minimum 20 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.

Your input will directly help improve AI models by ensuring they can handle complex, graduate-level questions across disciplines.

  • Create structured, graduate-level tasks, prompts, and problem sets in your area of expertise.
